author: Punalama
body:
I played Avicus for a time today,there was a glitch and everybody was flying. I dont play when there is a glitch to not to give mods a hard time when they are dealing with it so i logged out. When I logged in again, I saw that I was banned for hacking (fly). If you see my profile, I was banned before so I am extra careful with rules beacuse I love playing in this server. Please don't keep me banned for something I didn't do. And if you are going to unban me, can you please delete this banning report? Because it is a huge problem when you are trying to get into a team.

Thanks,
 Punalama

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Sorry for the misunderstanding. I have already requested for your infraction to be appealed. A mapdev is working on it and I wasn't aware at the time that it was a "glitch" until I saw it for myself. You will be appealed shortly

Regards,

GrapeSmoothie Avicus Moderator
